title: Sunday · the dock, after, 2018
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Four days after the Fourth: the dock, the ramp, spent tubes swept to a pile, the lawn chair with the girl of eight in it reading, and in the last tier the boy of five under the chair with the pup.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the dock in morning light, the plank ramp at the shack's door, a pile of spent tubes.

panels.composition: Tier 2: a girl of eight in the old lawn chair reading a paperback, feet not reaching the planks.

panels.composition: Tier 3: beneath the chair, a boy of five and a small three-legged dog lying flat, both looking at the reader.
